messages:
jules: Kicking off shadow DDL for orders -> new_orders_v2 now (maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC). Strategy: shadow-copy each shard, validate rowcounts + checksums, then final swap. If any shard copy lag > 15m or io errors, we'll abort that shard and run plan-B backfill. Deploybot will run copy jobs.

deploy-bot: queued shadow-ddl job sd-3344556677. estimated start ETA ~4m. (will post updates)

sam: acknowledged. i'll monitor replica lag and set alerts at 10m/15m. which app release is pinned for the canaries?

jules: pinned 2026.03.14-rc1 for canary pods. we'll unpin after validations pass.

deploy-bot: started copy: shard 0/8 -> shard 0 copy in progress. logs: `INFO sd-3344556677 shard=0 copied=0/1.2GB rate=120MB/s`

nia: heads up — shard 6 historically hits high IO. if it spikes we should cancel that shard copy and fallback. @sam can you set a 30m rollback timer?

sam: set pager for 30m. if we need to abort, run: `./tools/rollforward.sh --job sd-3344556677 --resume=false` and pin apps back to previous.

ops-bot: metric alert: replica_lag_shard6=18m (threshold=15m) — triggered at 02:17:42 UTC

jules: cancel shard 6 copy for now. do NOT pause global writes yet. plan: 1) cancel shard 6 copy 2) mark partition writes low (feature flag) 3) start throttled backfill for shard 6 in next window.

matt: suggest toggling feature flag to reduce writes on that tenant range: `ffctl set orders_partition6_write=false` — doing that now.

laura: after cancel, we'll run a quick consistency query against completed shards: `SELECT count(*) FROM new_orders_v2 WHERE migrated=false;` — i'll prepare the check script.

deploy-bot: job update sd-3344556677: shard 6 canceled by jules. progress: 6/8 shards completed, 1 paused, 1 in queue.

sam: rolling app canaries back to 2026.03.13-hotfix across all regions to lower write pressure. will confirm when done.

jules: decision: abort full automated rollout. we'll proceed with shards that completed and finish swap for those, but shard 6 will be skipped and backfilled from snapshot + throttled replay. No user-facing downtime expected.

laura: creating a short postmortem ticket now and adding the validation logs + graphs to it. tagging @eng-sre for follow-up on IO mitigation.

nia: quick checklist for rollback path B (short):
- cancel shard copy (done)
- pin app to previous release (sam done)
- feature flag reduce writes (matt done)
- run snapshot-based backfill for shard 6 at low priority next maintenance window
- run post-swap smoke: `curl -sS -H 'X-Test:1' ${SMOKE_ENDPOINT}/orders/health | jq .`

jules: thanks everyone. i'll update the release notes: "shadow DDL partially aborted — partition 6 skipped due to replica IO lag. Remaining partitions swapped. No customer-visible errors. Backfill for partition 6 scheduled."

matt: on it — will also add a throttling rule in the copy job to cap disk IO for future runs.

laura: postmortem ticket: INF-2026-129 created, link in the thread. attaching initial metrics.

sam: confirmed rollback complete on canaries, routing adjusted. monitoring for any write anomalies.

jules: final: keep an eye on the validation alerts for the swapped shards. if anything shows checksum mismatch, we'll open emergency rollback. otherwise we can unpin after 4 hours of stable metrics. :thumbsup:

nia: :thumbsup:

matt: :thumbsup:

laura: tagging QA to run the smoke suite next hour.

deploy-bot: sd-3344556677 status: paused (awaiting backfill schedule for shard 6)
